title: Interesting product that requires a lot of care
text:
Interesting product that requires a lot of care. The idea of a stainless steel wine glass was interesting to me. It wouldn't break if you were to drop it on the floor and it has a nice dark finish that makes it look high-end. The Arora Stainless Steel Wine Glass has a good build and elegant appearance.

My score regarding this product is completely subjective as I think others might actually really like it. For me, I was a little bit disappointed that the base of the wine glass is not solid. It is stainless steel bent to create the shape of the base and bevel, making it hollow.

In addition, this product is not dishwasher safe, but if you were to hand-wash it with a sponge, you have a chance of making scratches on the mirror surface which would really stand out. This means that you should use is only on wine, and you should probably rinse it immediately after use so that there wouldn't be a need to use a sponge on it.
